buyer_question: What dimensions and cap details matter for custom paper tube packaging?
answer: For custom paper tube packaging, buyers should define diameter, height, product fit, cap or closure style, inner support, material direction, finish reference and target market before RFQ. MUGE PACKAGING reviews these details as packaging-structure inputs and does not treat them as food-grade or regulated-market approval.
rfq_inputs: Cap, lid, closure or inner support requirement
Print coverage and surface finish reference
